description: Forgejo's swagger leaves off errors createOrgRepo returns (forgejo/forgejo v17.0.1, routers/api/v1/repo/repo.go, read 2026-11-01). CreateOrgRepo goes through CreateUserRepo, which answers 409 for a name that exists and 422 for a reserved name or one that breaks the name pattern, and answers 422 itself when the organization doesn't exist. createCurrentUserRepo declares both. Typed so a create can tell its own race from a failure.
